crossRefs.note: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he…
But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

translations.web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
translations.bsb: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich the house of a foreigner.
translations.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
translations.asv: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors be in the house of an alien,
